about: D-917 / B-796: OpenColorIO's own numbers for every Output an export offers with colour management on. Written by tools/output_reference.py; never edit by hand.

aces-view.colour_tag: sRGB IEC 61966-2-1, the ACES 2.0 SDR view

bar.picture: sRGB and Rec.709: |ours - expected| at most 1 level on every channel of every pixel, at 8 and at 16 bits. ACES view (D-915's baked table): at most 1 level of 255 on 99.9% of pixels at 8 bits, and at 16 bits at most 257 levels (1 of 255) on 99.9%; the rest reported
bar.exr: |ours - expected| at most 1e-6 times the colour's size (its largest channel, at least 1) on every channel of every pixel; alpha exact
bar.off: with colour management off every byte is what the export wrote before D-917
